description: Golden evaluation set for a speech-to-text (STT) harness. Each entry pairs an audio clip with its reference (ground-truth) transcript and a slice tag. Slices let us see WER (Word Error Rate) per condition, not just one average number - regressions usually show up in one slice first. An empty reference marks a silence clip: there is nothing to transcribe, so it is scored by its own hallucination check instead of WER.
